cand.title: IAGTO North America Golf Tourism Convention (NAC) 2027
cand.excerpt: High evidence and clear hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is discounted where a competing venue is named.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer-side commercial contacts are Sharon Wingrove, Membership & Events Manager, and Peter Walton, Chief Executive. Claudio DeMarchi is also publicly identified as IAGTO North America’s NAC enquiry contact. These are organizer/executive/market-development contacts, not proven hotel-contract signatories. No named individual 2027 accommodation buyer or appointed PCO/DMC was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed activity dates are 21–23 June 2027, within the requested horizon, not publication dates. The official programme separately lists early arrivals on 20 June; this does not change the main convention dates. No verified 2028 edition dates or location were found; do not infer June 2028 dates or a Dominican Republic return.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra’s 620-room Uvero Alto all-inclusive resort format fits guestroom-led golf leisure groups, small buyer familiarization stays and relationship-led golf packages better than a city-hotel proposition. However, its published 380 m² / three meeting facilities, 300 conference and 200 banquet capacities do not establish suitability for NAC’s two-day appointment layout and plenary requirements. The 254 delegates reported for 2026 are historical attendance, not room demand or a 2027 forecast. A future full-host pitch would require layout and catering validation plus separately secured golf access and transport. The 2027 programme uses Iberostar Bavaro and La Cana courses; no Alltra golf-access agreement was verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort by Meliá, Punta Cana, is the announced venue and delegate hotel. IAGTO explicitly says accommodation is included in the registration package and all delegates stay there. Opening address: Bavaro I & II; business appointments: Bavaro VI; welcome reception: resort beach; farewell dinner: Plaza Colonial. This is an explicit event-specific commitment, not a preferred-hotel listing. Executed contract terms are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent timeline: 17–19 June 2024, Mountain Grand Lodge & Spa, Boyne Falls, Northern Michigan; 17–19 June 2025, Birmingham, Alabama, with Sheraton Birmingham Hotel identified by a participating destination; 22–24 June 2026, Riviera Maya, Mexico, at Iberostar Selection Paraiso Lindo / the Iberostar Selection Paraiso resort and convention complex. The 2026 recap calls this the first NAC outside the USA and first with all delegates in one all-inclusive beach resort. The 2027 move to Punta Cana confirms rotation, not an annual Punta Cana pattern. The 2025 official launch dates are used rather than a separate article’s 16–19 June expanded activity window.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 core delegate lodging is committed elsewhere in the published package: all delegates at Paradisus Palma Real. Hotel sourcing is not verified open. No public external-hotel RFP, room-block size, peak rooms, package night allocation, or overflow appointment was located. Supplier registration is a trade-event participation pathway, not a hotel-sourcing invitation. The registration page accepts hotels and Caribbean suppliers; buyers must sell directly to golfers and contract directly with destination suppliers.
findings.organizationStructure: IAGTO means International Association of Golf Tour Operators, a golf-tourism trade membership organization. The Birmingham CVB describes NAC as owned and operated by IAGTO. The 2024 NAC release identifies IAGTO Ltd as registered in England as a Professional Membership Organisation. Paradisus Palma Real is the host hotel, not the event owner; participating golf tour operators are travel-product buyers, not automatically convention accommodation buyers. No separate appointed PCO or DMC was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The principal limitation is explicit: Paradisus Palma Real captures the packaged delegate lodging and on-site networking for 2027. No sourced sell-out, unmet room demand, overflow block or service shortfall was found. Do not count Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe activity as Alltra room demand. Inference: moving delegates off-site would weaken the published single-resort format; no transfer time or cost is assumed.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Sharon Wingrove first, citing the confirmed Paradisus package: request supplier participation terms, relevant golf-buyer matching, and confirmation whether any sanctioned independent pre/post stays or fam programme remains unallocated. Engage Claudio DeMarchi for golf-tour-operator introductions and Peter Walton for future-host selection process and destination rotation, without implying either controls hotel contracting. Present an Alltra guestroom-led all-inclusive proposal with proposed golf/transfer partnerships and a validated meeting layout. Do not quote a convention block, forecast overflow, or displace the incumbent in pipeline reporting absent a specific invitation.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is accessible as a potential supplier-participation/relationship-development channel, subject to acceptance and available places, not as a verified open accommodation sale. Hotels and Caribbean suppliers are eligible to apply through the published registration pathway. Core event and lodging are already assigned to a competitor; residual stays or fam tours must not be presented as available business without organizer confirmation.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: annual recurrence, rotation and the 2026–2027 all-inclusive beach-resort format justify a longer-term IAGTO relationship and conditional future-host discussion. They do not establish an open hosting competition, a 2028 date, or a future Punta Cana edition. More immediately, accepted supplier participation could support direct relationships with golf tour operators for subsequent independent golf-group stays, subject to product distribution, golf access and transport arrangements.
